data.narrative: Completed Module 7 Security & Architecture Review - chose AI-assisted hybrid review. AI first-pass scan found auth/permission gaps, human manual review on critical path (auth, permissions, data mutation, roles). Found 1 CRITICAL (role management no permission tests), 2 HIGH findings. Fixed privilege escalation with 6 explicit constraints, 13 test cases pass. Architecture: patterns consistent, naming consistent, error handling consistent. Learned AI cannot judge business logic, security in context, architectural coherence - humans check semantics.

dimension_scores.observation: Security fix prompts specific with multiple explicit constraints. Privilege escalation fix: 6 constraints (admin/owner only, no self-modification, validate role enum, admin cannot promote to owner, audit log, write tests). Not vague 'fix security' prompts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Fix prompt: 'Fix privilege escalation in PUT /teams/:id/members/:uid. 1) Only admin/owner can modify roles. 2) User cannot modify own role. 3) Validate role against enum. 4) Admin cannot promote to owner. 5) Add audit log entry. 6) Write tests for each constraint.'

dimension_scores.observation: System-level review across 5 categories: business logic, security in context, architectural coherence, data integrity, compliance. Created auth map, input validation audit, IDOR check, secrets audit, dependency audit. Test coverage map identified critical gap in role management permission tests. Found privilege escalation exploit from combination of findings.
dimension_scores.evidence: system-review-findings.md: 'Security findings: 1 CRITICAL (role management no permission tests), 2 HIGH (admin edit/delete on comments, expired invitation). Architecture: pattern consistency OK, naming OK, error handling OK. Test coverage map shows critical gap in role management.'

dimension_scores.observation: AI-assisted scan efficient - found patterns across all code quickly. Human manual review focused on critical path (auth, permissions, data mutation, roles, personal data). Fixed CRITICAL and HIGH findings in one iteration. 13 test cases verify fix. No regressions introduced. AI scanner blind spots compensated by human critical path review.
dimension_scores.evidence: Decision: 'AI-assisted + manual critical path. AI first-pass scan: find endpoints without auth, DB queries without validation, error responses with stack traces. Manual review on critical path: auth, permissions, role checks, data mutation. Faster than full manual, human catches semantic issues AI misses.'

dimension_scores.observation: Chose AI-assisted hybrid over full manual. Full manual too slow - loses focus after 18 files. AI scanner efficient but has blind spots (trained on same patterns as generator). Human critical path on auth/permissions most effective time allocation. Recognized AI checks syntax, humans check semantics. Individual findings compose into exploits - system-level review essential.
dimension_scores.evidence: Reflection: 'AI cannot judge business logic, security in context, architectural coherence. AI checks syntax, humans check semantics. AI-assisted scan + manual critical path balances speed and thoroughness. Time allocation on auth/permissions most effective.'

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped security-audited, architecturally consistent code. CRITICAL and HIGH findings resolved. Privilege escalation fixed with 6 constraints, 13 test cases pass. Auth map complete, input validation audit, IDOR check, secrets audit, dependency audit. Architecture patterns consistent. Full test suite green. No regressions. Security checklist reusable.
dimension_scores.evidence: system-review-findings.md: 'Prioritized fix list: 1 CRITICAL (role management permission tests) fixed, 2 HIGH (admin edit/delete comments, expired invitation) fixed. 13 test cases verify: viewer escalation blocked, member escalation blocked, admin can change member/viewer, admin cannot promote to owner, owner can do everything.'
